text:
zoe: Heads-up: prepping a targeted admin-entitlement cleanup next quarter. want to sketch scope and playbook here before i raise the formal card. cc @ben @amar

ben: +1. can you define the sweep criteria? are we trimming ownerless only or also reducing cross-project admin roles?

zoe: plan proposal: two-phase sweep. Phase A (discovery) - run entitlement census for admin-like roles across org, flag principals with >1 project admin scope or ownerless for >90 days. Phase B (remediation) - ownerproof -> temporary demotion -> prune if no valid justification. aim: reduce surface and get owners on record.

amar: sounds good. add a special constraint for KMS-related admin roles: any principal with KMS key grants in last 6 months gets manual review. can't prune blindly.

zoe: noted. also propose we exclude billing and payments roles from auto-prune and instead require a compliance exception flow.

ben: metrics to collect: count of admin principals, delta after prune, # of ownerproof responses, and any incidents triggered. also need a safe window for teams to opt-out.

audits-bot: SUGGEST: include audit-evidence bundle per principal: recent grant events, last_owner_change, justification_history, okta_session_refs. emit a CSV for the quarterly access review import.

mira: timeline ask  can we run a dry-run in two weeks? we'd like to present results at the security sync and get buy-in.

zoe: yes. dry-run schedule: discovery-run next Monday, ownerproof dispatch Tuesday, aggregate results Friday. full sweep (if approved) targeted for next quarter.

amar: playbook checklist proposal: 1) discovery export 2) filter KMS-sensitive 3) ownerproof email + 7-day window 4) temp role-lock (read-only) after 7 days 5) manual compliance exception for excluded roles 6) prune and document 7) post-prune monitoring for errors for 72h.

ben: add alerting: if any pruned principal performs a write or admin attach within 72h, auto-open a P1 incident. also add a preview report for teams 48h before prune.

mira: ownerproof email draft idea: short, actionable, with one-click accept or handback ticket link. example: "We detected missing or stale ownership for principal=svc-report@proj-corp. Reply with owner email or open handback ticket within 7d or principal will be queued for entitlement pruning."

zoe: agree. include an escalation header for managers if no response in 7 days.

audits-bot: NOTE: tag all ownerproof responses into evidence bucket incident-ops/access-review-2026-q2. Ensure retention 1y for compliance.

compliance-bot: POLICY: ensure KMS key owners are CC'd on any demotion. For billing roles, require a manual runbook verification and escalated approval from Finance Security.

ben: operational question  who runs the prune? infra or security ops?

amar: security ops executes prune with infra-runbook for role changes and revocations; infra provides the safe scripts and a rollback path.

zoe: next steps: i'll create card "Q2 entitlement sweep - dry run" and assign to ben/am ar/mira. i'll attach discovery query, sample ownerproof template, and the prune-runbook. dry-run next Monday.

mira: one last ask  can we include a short blurb for product teams explaining why we need owner metadata? want to reduce surprise.

o e:  will draft that and share by EOD Friday.

ben: thanks all. marking this thread as the canonical discussion for the sweep. will update with discovery output. :white_check_mark:
